verdict.rationale: Windows has extensive developer and support documentation, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. Probes found HTTP 404 for llms.txt and for a markdown version of the docs on support.microsoft.com, and nothing in the pack documents any agent-oriented documentation. Confidence is medium rather than high because the probes covered only support.microsoft.com, not learn.microsoft.com.
